name: Hydrogen
description: Hydrogen is a basic element essential to life, forms water and organic compounds.

name: Helium
description: Helium is chemically inert and biologically non-reactive.

name: Lithium
description: Used in psychiatry; its biological effects are under study for cancer therapy.

name: Beryllium
description: Toxic metal with limited biological role, exposure linked to lung disease.

name: Boron
description: Used in boron neutron capture therapy, an experimental cancer treatment.

name: Carbon
description: Basis of all organic life; carbon nanomaterials are studied for drug delivery.

name: Nitrogen
description: Essential element in amino acids and nucleic acids.

name: Oxygen
description: Critical for cell metabolism and oxygenation; hypoxia influences tumor growth.

name: Fluorine
description: Highly reactive and toxic; used in pharmaceuticals but harmful in excess.

name: Neon
description: Chemically inert, no known biological activity.

name: Sodium
description: Vital electrolyte for nerve and muscle function.

name: Magnesium
description: Important for DNA repair and cell function.
